jobs.description:
Conceptual Art Director

Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Art Director with a passion for Generative AI to create bold, high-performing digital campaigns for top global brands. In this role, you’ll partner with copywriters, strategists and creatives to deliver concept-driven ideas across social media, web, video, and more—bringing big ideas to life with strong art direction and design execution.

You’ll thrive in a collaborative, globally distributed team and contribute to work that’s not only creatively exciting but also strategically sharp. This is a role for someone who can think big, execute beautifully, and bring a deep understanding of design to everything they do.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with copywriters and strategists to develop compelling creative campaigns across digital-first channels (social, web, video) with the ability to stretch into ATL (TV, print, OOH).
  • Lead art direction for creative campaigns and video concepts, providing visual direction from ideation through final execution.
  • Design or direct the creation of digital assets, mood boards, layouts, and visual frameworks that bring brand narratives to life.
  • Integrate AI-assisted assets into workflows while maintaining brand integrity and emotional impact.
  • Contribute to brand storytelling by developing concept-led brand systems and integrated creative ideas.
  • Build and present creative decks that clearly communicate concepts and strategy to customers.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and other creatives across time zones.
  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously, consistently delivering on time, on budget, and to the highest quality.
  • Help push creative boundaries, championing fresh ideas and evolving Superside’s conceptual capabilities.
  • Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to understand goals and deliver work that drives results.
  • Contribute to a culture of excellence, experimentation, and continuous creative growth.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in concept-driven roles within creative agencies or fast-paced in-house teams.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing concept-first thinking and excellent art direction across digital platforms.

  • Passion for creativity and a strong eye for design, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence presenting ideas to customers and internal teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with experience juggling multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently in a remote setting.

jobs.description:
Communication & Events Manager

About Taurus

Join the Next Global FinTech Success Story

Are you ready to be part of a bold entrepreneurial journey and help shape the future of finance? At Taurus, we're building the next-generation digital asset infrastructure, and we might just have the perfect opportunity for you.

Headquartered in Switzerland, Taurus is a leading financial technology company specializing in digital asset infrastructure. Our fully integrated, modular platform empowers financial institutions to manage the entire lifecycle of digital assets, including custody, tokenization, and trading. We are trusted by corporate & investment banks, private banks, asset managers, broker-dealers, custodians and crypto banks.

As we expand globally, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our team and help accelerate our growth. If you’re passionate about innovation, blockchain technology, and the future of finance, we want to hear from you.

Your role

Reporting to the CMO and working closely with the Head of Taurus-NETWORK Partnerships & Marketing, you will own Taurus's communication and events outside the US: PR, social media, design and collateral, and our worldwide events program. You will be the day-to-day lead for our PR and design agencies, and will work hand in hand with the marketing automation and US partnerships & events teams.

What you will do

  • PR & communication: manage our PR & communication agency day to day: press releases, announcements, media relations, interview and speaking opportunities, and the PR calendar

  • Coordinate corporate and partner announcements with internal stakeholders (product, partnerships, legal) to ensure accurate and compliant messaging

  • Social media: run Taurus's organic social media, primarily LinkedIn: editorial calendar, post production, community engagement, performance reporting and paid advertising.

  • Design & collateral: manage our design agency to deliver collateral, event materials, presentations and visual assets consistent with the Taurus brand identity

  • Brand & content: support the team on thought leadership, turning white papers, case studies, product launches and partner news into posts, articles, newsletters and event content

  • Events (worldwide, excl. US): own the events program end to end (conferences, trade shows, roundtables, client and partner events, webinars), from selection, sponsorship and budget through logistics, on-site delivery and post-event follow-up, with clear pipeline objectives for each event

  • Coordinate the global events calendar with the US events lead so that sponsorships, messaging and materials stay consistent across regions

  • Measure the impact of each event (meetings, leads, pipeline) and ensure leads are captured in the CRM and followed up, working with marketing automation and sales

  • Coherence & cadence: own a single integrated communication calendar that links content, company and partner news, client acquisition campaigns and events, so Taurus communicates regularly and with one consistent message.

Requirements

A successful candidate will have:

  • A strong background in communication, PR and/or events within a financial services and/or digital asset company

  • Expertise in Product Marketing is a plus.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree

  • 5+ years’ experience in communication, PR or events marketing, ideally in a high-growth B2B company

  • A proven track record of organizing international conferences and trade shows end to end, including vendor management and budget control

  • Experience managing PR and creative agencies

  • Hands-on social media experience, especially on LinkedIn; familiarity with design tools (e.g. Canva, Figma) and video tools.

  • A passion for blockchain-based software and financial technology is a strong plus

  • Obsessed with execution: driven to achieve goals

  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a team player

  • Strong writing and communication skills

  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

  • Willingness to travel regularly for events

  • Fluent in French and English

What we offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and finance

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts

  • A fast-paced learning environment, entrepreneurial spirit and team spirit

  • A great moment to join as the company grows and expands

  • State-of-the-art technology and IT infrastructure

  • Hybrid remote work and flexible working hours

  • Fun team events

Closing

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. As such, there will be significant growth opportunities for candidates with an open and deliver mindset. We are an equal opportunity employer.

In line with our pay transparency policy, the salary range for this role is disclosed to all candidates prior to the first interview.

We will not consider applications via agencies.

jobs.title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
jobs.description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)

Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.


Salary & terms of employment

•      Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience

•      Year-end bonus, dependent on company results

•      25 holiday days per year

•      Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours

•      Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium

•      Laptop and phone provided


Working environment

•      Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data

•      Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines

•      Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme

•      An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative


Ready to build with us?

Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you.

Send your application and CV or LinkedIn profile to Questions about this vacancy? Get in touch with our Corporate Recruiter Veroniek Smits at the same address.

Please note that for this role we do not work with recruitment agencies, and we're unable to accept unsolicited candidate submissions or related fees.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role


The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate.

Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other
member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time.

At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do


You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will:


● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally.
● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person.
● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works.
● Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
● Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands the client's goals and legal and professional services workflows, surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora.
● Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and value reviews.
● Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination globally.
● Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the account.
● Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.


What You Bring


You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:


● 5+ years experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.
● Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable, we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms.
● A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations.
● Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes.
● A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
● Experience leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will set the direction that colleagues in other regions deliver against, so you need to be able to bring people with you.
● Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.
● Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident.
● Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams.
● High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.
● A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.
● Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process.
● Willingness to travel internationally around 25% of the time.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.description:
Head of Technology

We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

â How we work:

We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly:Â Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products:Â In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

â Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

Weâre excited to hear from you! â¤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)

Senior Events & Brand Manager (f/m/x)

Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

As Senior Events & Brand Manager (f/m/x), you won't just be booking booths and ordering giveaways. You'll shape how exmox shows up at the industry's most important conferences, in the press and for our own team, deciding where we go, what we do there and how we make it count, turning events into moments that partners, talent and the industry remember. And 2027 starts big: the move of our Hamburg HQ to Mönckebergstraße and the opening of our Berlin office are yours to make unforgettable.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you bring taste, pace and a real feel for the mobile and tech scene, let's talk.

In this role you will:

  • Industry Events & Conferences: Plan and deliver exmox's presence at the conferences that matter in mobile gaming and adtech, from booths and speaking slots to side events and partner dinners, and help decide where we show up and where we skip.
  • Own Formats: Create events that are distinctly exmox, the kind partners make time for, and grow them into formats that come back year after year.
  • Office Openings: Lead the opening of our new Hamburg HQ and our Berlin office as brand moments, inside and outside the company.
  • PR: Steer our PR partners day to day, set priorities and turn our events and milestones into stories worth covering.
  • Internal Events & Merch: Shape the concept and experience of our internal events, with our Office Management team running the operations, and decide what merch and swag we produce, why and when, together with our Brand team.
  • Budget & Commercial Impact: Manage event budgets and suppliers, work with Sales and Account Management to turn every event into partner meetings and opportunities, and measure what each event and campaign delivers, so every euro is spent on impact rather than attendance.

What You Bring

  • Relevant Experience: You have 5 - 7 years of experience in event management, brand experience or experiential marketing, ideally in mobile gaming, adtech or another tech environment.
  • Proven Delivery: You've planned and delivered conference presences, side events and corporate events end to end, including budgets, vendors and on-site execution. Experience working with PR agencies or media is a plus.
  • Taste & Ideas: You know the difference between an event people attend and one they talk about, and you have the ideas to create the second kind.
  • Hands-On & Organized: You move easily between the big picture and the details, and you stay calm when things change at the last minute.
  • Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English and German, and willingness to travel internationally.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Senior Software Engineer

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI and software systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML/software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise and confident client-facing skills.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML and software systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML/software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

Who we're looking for:

  • You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Performance Engineer

UK | Full-Time

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

  • True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership:

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”

The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O

We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

What You’ll Work On

  • System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.

  • Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.

  • Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.

  • Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.

  • Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.

  • Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.

  • Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.

  • Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.

  • Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness

  • Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

 

A Note on Our Search

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

Why Join Source.dev?

  • AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.

  • Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

  • Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.

  • Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.

  • Elite Engineering Culture: Join a high-trust & passionate team of engineers

Sr. Software Engineer II / Tech lead, Agentic Platform (Poland, Remote, B2B)

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

  • Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.
  • Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.
  • Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.
  • Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical discussions with teammates to identify gaps in our telematics data platform and influence roadmap by setting direction and recommending solutions
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to make design decisions and understand downstream implications in our product to ensure a seamless customer experience
  • Ship features that deliver value to customers, consistently refining them based on gathered feedback.
  • Deliver full stack features across multiple tiers (front-end, back-end and mobile). GoLang, GraphQL, Typescript, React and ReactNative among other technologies. Direct experience with these technologies is not required.
  • Be responsible for maintaining the production systems that your team owns and provide operational support.
  • Make an impact on our core architecture, roadmap, and the wider engineering community.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on work building and operating complex enterprise systems.
  • A track record of turning partially defined customer or business challenges into technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes with substantial autonomy.
  • Strong system design judgment, including service boundaries, dependencies, failure modes, performance, and safe changes to production systems.
  • Experience leading delivery through deep ownership of a critical system or coordination across multiple services and teams, balancing immediate needs with long-term architecture.
  • Ability to improve other engineers’ effectiveness through mentoring, design reviews, and clear technical decisions.
  • Extensive use of AI throughout engineering, including complex investigations and design exploration, with the ability to validate results and help teammates adopt effective workflows.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building customer-facing web and mobile workflow applications
  • Contributed heavily to driving significant value to their customers
  • Curiosity about our customers, and is eager to improve their day-to-day experience
  • Seeks to iterate on new products based on customer feedback
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.Strong communication skills for effective teamwork and project collaboration.
  • Enthusiastic and committed to innovating in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment.
  • Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from enterprise-scale, production work.
    • Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences.
    • Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation.
    • Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action.
    • Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products.
    • Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

638 350 zł—751 000 zł PLN

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager

We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl

  • Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people

  • Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have

  • Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together

  • Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work

  • Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape

  • Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing

  • Dental insurance, including family cover

  • A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked

  • A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you

  • Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term

About the Interview

  • Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations)

  • Stage 2: Short task

  • Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops)

Additional Details

  • Location: London, Holborn

  • Team: Finance

  • Reports to: CEO

  • Working arrangement: Hybrid (4+ Days in Office)

We care deeply for each other and believe the best ideas come from honest debate, real feedback, and diverse perspectives. It's a culture built on trust, exceptional work, and genuine respect for the people around us.

Who thrives here:

Thinkific may be the right place if you're energized by a fast-paced environment, enjoy high autonomy, and work well with ambiguity and change. You thrive in highly collaborative teams and make the people around you better. You're results-driven, take ownership without being asked, have hard conversations even when it's uncomfortable, and celebrate diverse perspectives. AI is a tool you embrace to move faster and think bigger.

Who doesn't thrive here:

About the Role

Are you energized by complex, cross-functional challenges — the kind where you’re the person who brings clarity to ambiguity, momentum to high-stakes initiatives, and trust to every room you walk into? We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join us at Thinkific.

This role sits within our Program Management team inside Research & Development — a small but mighty team that operates at the heart of how Thinkific delivers. This team is a strategic force multiplier, owning complex end-to-end initiatives operating at the intersection of people, product, and AI-augmented delivery.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at every level — engineers, product managers, executives, and external partners. You’ll surface trade-offs clearly, manage competing priorities, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction

  • Leverage AI as a force multiplier. You already integrate AI tools into how you work — drafting status updates, synthesizing risk signals, generating meeting summaries and documentation, and accelerating decision-making

  • Translate business objectives into executable project plans by identifying dependencies, sequencing work intelligently, and proactively flagging when scope, timeline, or resources need to shift

  • Anticipate problems before they become blockers. You’ll build contingency plans, facilitate hard conversations early, and keep stakeholders informed

  • Define and reinforce standards for how we ship — quality gates, rollout plans, retrospectives, and post-mortems that actually lead to change

  • Own executive-level AI-assisted reporting with clear, opinionated status updates, risk dashboards, and decision-ready briefings

The person we have in mind likely:

  • Has 5+ years of experience in technical project management or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a software or SaaS environment

  • Is genuinely technical. They don’t need to write code, but understand how software is built and what makes an architecture decision hard

  • Is AI-fluent. They actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Notion AI, or similar) in their day-to-day work. They’re comfortable helping teams define guardrails for responsible AI use in workflows

  • Is a systems thinker who holds the whole picture — dependencies, risks, resource constraints, business context — while staying sharp on the details that matter most

  • Communicates with clarity and confidence. They write concisely, adapt their message to their audience, and can explain technical blockers in plain language

  • Is experienced with modern delivery frameworks (Agile, Scrum, Kanban)

  • Loves to learn and grow. They’ve found (and keep looking for) ways to level up their skills in this field, whether that’s through formal education, gaining professional experience, or maybe even building their own business

These things would also be nice, but we think you could learn them on the job:

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS or learning product company

  • Familiarity with evaluating and rolling out AI tooling within engineering or product teams

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification

  • Experience managing vendor relationships or third-party integrations at scale

The range is designed to capture the full journey from developing skills to excelling in the position. At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions.   • Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options.

Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

Nice to Have
